# NewCo Studio

> NewCo Studio is a UK-based web studio that builds fixed-price one-page websites for small businesses for £99 and fixes problems on existing websites, spreadsheets and scripts from £19. It works remotely with clients across the UK and worldwide, sends a written fixed quote within 24 hours, and takes payment by UK bank transfer: 50% to start and 50% after sign-off. Prices are in GBP (£). Prices as stated. VAT is not charged.

## Key facts
- Name: NewCo Studio (UK). Website: https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/
- Run by: Keith Bullock
- Based in: United Kingdom. Serves: small businesses across the UK and worldwide, remotely.
- One-page website: £99 (services, prices, photos and contact details on one mobile-friendly page; basic SEO, favicon, share image; all files handed over). Prices as stated. VAT is not charged.
- Website fix: from £19 (broken links, wrong contact details, buttons or forms that don't work, pages that look wrong on phones; spreadsheet and script fixes too). Prices as stated. VAT is not charged. A fix request can include a page address and an optional screenshot.
- Bigger sites: fixed quote in writing
- Payment: UK bank transfer, 50% to start and 50% after sign-off. £19 fixes are paid once approved.
- Delivery: website and fix work is files and a preview link, not a parcel, with no shipping charge. The published window is one to five days, and the written quote names the date. Finished website and fix work is not returned; further edits after delivery are new fixed-price jobs from £19. Spreadsheet files are instant downloads on Etsy, with no physical shipping from the studio. Etsy handles any refund on those downloads. See https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/delivery/
- Quotes: written fixed quote within 24 hours via https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/#quote
- Ownership: clients own all files; domain and hosting stay in the client's name. No hosting sold, no subscription.
- Contact: keith@newcopacks.co.uk
- Spreadsheets: UK bookkeeping and tax spreadsheets for Excel and Google Sheets, sold on Etsy (https://counterbookuk.etsy.com). UK listing prices, including UK VAT: The Counter Book 2026/27 for sole traders £11.99 (seller price before UK VAT £9.99), UK Etsy Seller Bookkeeping £9.59 (seller price £7.99), UK Maker Pricing and Stock £7.19 (seller price £5.99), UK Landlord Tracker £10.79 (seller price £8.99). Etsy prices may vary by buyer location. That VAT is Etsy's charge, not the studio's.

## Disambiguation
NewCo Studio at studio.newcopacks.co.uk is a UK small-business web studio. It is not connected to other organisations using the name "NewCo Studio".
